content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 28-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CSIR NEIST to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CSIR NEIST Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for CSIR NEIST Recruitment 2026 is 28 September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in CSIR NEIST Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: CSIR NEIST has announced a total of 4 vacancies for the posts of Junior Stenographer, Junior Secretariat Assistant, and Junior Hindi Translator.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for Junior Stenographer?
faq.answer: For the Junior Stenographer post, candidates must have completed 10+2/XII or its equivalent and possess proficiency in stenography as per DoPT norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the posts advertised by CSIR NEIST?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the advertised posts is 30 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government regulations.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for CSIR NEIST Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application process for CSIR NEIST Recruitment 2026 is entirely online. Candidates need to apply through the official website.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for a Junior Secretariat Assistant?
faq.answer: The Junior Secretariat Assistant post comes with a salary as per Pay Level-2, ranging from Rs. 19,900 to Rs. 63,200/- as per the 7th CPC.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for CSIR NEIST Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any specific application fee for this recruitment drive. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any updates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the starting date for the online application?
faq.answer: The online application process for CSIR NEIST Recruitment 2026 begins on 29 August 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Which university degree is required for Junior Hindi Translator?
faq.answer: For the Junior Hindi Translator post, a Master's degree from a recognized University in Hindi or English is required, with English or Hindi as a compulsory or elective subject.
